name: Winona Camps for Boys
description_short: A traditional boys' summer camp in western Maine, founded in 1908. Campers live in canvas tents on Moose Pond and learn outdoor living skills along with activities like rock climbing, kayaking and lacrosse.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on the shores of Moose Pond. The page does not describe swim instruction or waterfront rules.
